sentences.text: Commissioning shall be planned as a controlled sequence that proves each control function before the plant relies on it for normal service.
Each commissioning test shall have defined starting conditions, expected responses, acceptance limits, and a responsible reviewer.
Before wet commissioning begins, the Duty Engineer shall confirm that temporary controls, bypasses, and manual operating instructions are understood by the affected staff.

Functional testing shall verify that the River Intake Pump Station, Raw Water Screen Channel, North Filter Gallery, South Filter Gallery, and Coagulant Dosing Skid respond correctly to local and supervisory commands.
During integrated testing, Juniper shall demonstrate stable pressure control through startup, lead-lag transfer, and controlled shutdown.
The SCADA Historian Server shall be checked for correct time synchronization, tag naming, data retention, and retrieval of key commissioning trends.
The Chlorine Contact Basin and Clearwell Level Controller shall be tested under representative level, flow, and residual control conditions before treated water is released for routine distribution.
Storm Intake Mode shall be exercised in a planned drill that confirms operator prompts, intake constraints, and return-to-normal steps.
A Chlorine Residual Alarm test shall verify annunciation, operator response guidance, acknowledgement behavior, and escalation to the appropriate duty staff.
The Chief Operator shall coordinate training so that operators understand the control concept, normal sequencing, manual fallback methods, and alarm response expectations.
Operator training shall include classroom review, simulator or dry-run practice where practical, field walkdowns, and supervised operation during early service.
The Laboratory Technician shall be trained on sample timing, result entry, data review responsibilities, and communication of unusual water quality findings.
The Maintenance Planner shall review commissioning defects, recurring nuisance alarms, calibration drift, and equipment access problems before preventive maintenance intervals are finalized.
The Maintenance Planner shall use the clip to compare observed pump condition with planned inspection intervals and corrective work priorities.
Feedback from maintenance work orders shall be reviewed with operations so that control changes do not mask equipment degradation or create avoidable field effort.
Distribution readiness shall be declared only after pressure control, reservoir or clearwell constraints, communications, and emergency contact paths have been verified.
Falcon shall confirm that distribution readiness messages are acknowledged before any planned change in pressure zone operating status.
Before distribution readiness is declared, the South Distribution Pressure Station shall use the card to confirm zone status, valve lineup, and communication checks.
The North Distribution Pressure Station shall be included in readiness checks for telemetry validity, pump permissives, local alarm indication, and operator communications.
During commissioning of residuals handling, the Residuals Hauler shall use the Backwash Solids Manifest to confirm load identity, destination, and acceptance requirements.
The Chemical Supplier Driver shall follow site access, unloading, verification, and communication procedures established during commissioning and confirmed during training.
Records generated during commissioning and early operation shall be complete enough to support troubleshooting, regulatory review, warranty claims, and future operator training.
Records retention shall follow municipal policy and applicable drinking water requirements, with electronic records protected against unauthorized change and accidental loss.
Periodic performance reviews shall compare actual plant operation with the control concept, including alarm burden, manual interventions, water quality stability, chemical use, and energy use.
Continuous improvement actions shall be prioritized by risk, reviewed by the Chief Operator and Duty Engineer, tested before release, and incorporated into updated procedures and training materials.
